title: AdMatchingOptOutDocument
description: Server-only record that one phone number or email is opted out of ad matching (docs/ads_conversion_spec.md, Ad-matching notice and opt-out). Keyed by a domain-separated SHA-256 of the digest the ad platforms receive, so the conversion queue and the customer-list job can check it from the digests they hold. The raw phone or email is never stored. Permanent until staff remove it; a removal keeps the record with who removed it.

optOutId.description: SHA-256 of `catch-ad-matching-opt-out-v1:{kind}:{digest}`, where the digest is the SHA-256 of the E.164 phone or of the trimmed, lowercased email.

source.description: support: recorded from a person's request to Catch support; admin: recorded by staff on Catch's own decision.

status.description: Only an active record stops ad matching.

note.description: Short staff note, such as the support conversation it came from. Never the phone number or email.

createdByUid.description: The staff member who recorded the opt-out.

removedByUid.description: The staff member who removed the opt-out.
